user.title: E-Control Tarifkalkulator
user.description: Choose the data source, the postal code and the energy types to compare.

partner.title: Partner interface
partner.description: The partner interface needs the credentials of a tariff calculator partner account. Its resource paths are derived from the public interface and could not be verified against the productive service.

consumption.title: Consumption
consumption.description: Yearly consumption used for the comparison. The interface accepts values between 1 and 100000 kWh.

error.invalid_zip_code: Enter a four digit Austrian postal code.
error.no_energy_type: Select at least one energy type.
error.cannot_connect: The E-Control interface could not be reached.
error.invalid_auth: The partner interface rejected the credentials.
error.invalid_response: The E-Control interface answered in an unexpected way.

abort.already_configured: This postal code is already configured for the selected energy types.

settings.title: Comparison settings
settings.description: Consumption, discount handling and polling. Changing a value reloads the integration.

data.offer_count: Number of offers in the attributes

product.title: Product to compare against
product.description: Pick the energy type whose own product should be changed.

product_select.title: Product to compare against
product_select.description: Pick the {energy_type} product you hold a contract for. The savings of the other offers are calculated against this product.

abort.no_products: No products could be loaded from the E-Control interface. Try again later or reload the integration.
